subject: RepSession is your shape (D-contracts-007)
body: stateId; phase recode|test|future-pace|null; trigger.kind adds onboarding; step kinds rate|strategy-step|leverage|anchor-peak|anchor, each with stepIndex (required for strategy-step, anchor-peak and anchor) and driversSpoken (indexes into differences); plannedMs is null for rate. Plus profileId, repIndex, anchorPaired, recoveryCensored, signalSource, scriptHash, endedBy incl. user-stop/timeout. The schema forces shams to log only rate steps. validateRepSession(s, profile) checks stepIndex and that anchor steps use the state's anchorStep. API: run(profile, stateId, trigger, host, detection?) -> {session, stop}, fromOnboarding, progress -> ProgressByState (StateProgress in src/reps.ts; adjust it if your installed rule needs more). Helpers: repSteps(state), driversForStep(state, i). rep-log.demo.json has 11 reps ending installed under D-reps-003.
